prompt: A rain-wet freight yard at night, seen from low between the rails, 40mm, tilted a few degrees. A long-faced man of about 72 with white stubble, a black derby tipped back, sits in the open door of a 1920s boxcar, three-quarter and chest-up, filling a third of the frame height, a revolver hanging pointed at the ground. Behind him the boxcar's false floor is torn up, whiskey cases packed in the cavity. Beyond, a locomotive vents steam. A magenta gelled lamp on the yard office paints his face and mouth; a lime-green signal lamp streaks down the wet steel rails and the polished black boiler, with the locomotive's headlamp burning white through the steam. Thanks.
